sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of nervous disorders and fevers. It is useful in cases of malarial conditions and neuralgic pains. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of headaches and mental fatigue.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Neuralgic pains in the head.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Picric acid; China; Arsenicum album.
